node.label: Judiciary & appointments
node.summary: Collegium, judicial appointments, pendency and court administration.

facts.text: SC asked **MeitY** to frame measures against commercial misuse of **live-streamed court proceedings**; Prashant Bhushan suggested digital watermarks on official clips.

facts.text: Madras HC Chief Justice: **Sushrut Arvind Dharmadhikari** (First Bench with Justice G. Arul Murugan) issued notice on a PIL questioning the nationality of Cockroach Janta Party co-convener Saurav Das.

facts.text: The **99th Amendment (2014)** created the **NJAC** (CJI, 2 senior judges, Law Minister, 2 eminent persons); the SC struck it down in **2015** (Fourth Judges case) for violating judicial independence. Abroad: UK's Judicial Appointments Commission has **15** members; South Africa's Judicial Service Commission **23**.

facts.text: **Article 124** (SC judges) and **Article 217** (HC judges): appointed by the President after consultation. **First Judges case (1981)**: executive primacy; **Second (1993)**: created the collegium; **Third (1998)**: CJI + 4 senior-most judges for SC, CJI + 2 for HCs. **Memorandum of Procedure**: 1998.

facts.text: Ex-SC judge **Sanjay Kishan Kaul** said former CJI **D.Y. Chandrachud** may have discussed names with the Centre before the collegium met ('pre-approval'), reviving the transparency debate.
